name: Gasket
author: Erin Carter
description: Concentric glowing rings crossed by radial spokes, like a circular LED grid or a luminous manhole cover. Charge pulses outward through the rings while the hue turns with radius and angle, all over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Ring spacing
params.effect: Spacing between concentric rings in CSS pixels - many fine rings at the minimum, a few wide ones at the maximum.

params.label: Tube weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing ring and spoke in CSS pixels, from a hairline trace to a fat neon tube.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge rippling outward through the rings; 0 freezes it, high sends pulses racing to the edge.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around rings and spokes; low is crisp, high a luminous bloom.

params.label: Spokes
params.effect: Number of radial spokes dividing the wheel, from a sparse cross to a dense sunburst cage.

params.label: Colour blend
params.effect: Heals the colour seam on the left where the hue wraps; low keeps the original half-wheel pinwheel, high turns the hue through one seamless full rainbow per revolution.

params.label: Cell fill
params.effect: Fraction of grid cells that light up as a solid glowing dot inside the rings and spokes; 0 leaves the wheel open, high fills it like a circular LED matrix.

params.label: Fill size
params.effect: Size of each filled dot within its cell, from a small bead to a block that nearly meets the surrounding rings and spokes.

params.label: Twinkle
params.effect: Makes the filled cells breathe in and out, each on its own random phase, so the wheel shimmers.

params.label: Pattern
params.effect: Re-rolls which cells fill and their twinkle phases for a fresh arrangement of the same wheel.
